metadata.title: Clean-Room Reconstructed Source Architectural Pattern & Provenance Rules
metadata.description: Authoritative registry of clean-room architectural rules, adapter specifications, and implementation choice guidelines governing functions without 1-to-1 binary disassemblies.

RULE-ADAPTER-COORDINATOR.title: Top-level lifecycle and coordinator adapter wiring
RULE-ADAPTER-COORDINATOR.description: Defines constructors, configuration mutators, and lifecycle coordination methods (e.g., NewCoordinator, SetCameraConfig, SetSignalingClient) that assemble independently reconstructed components into a unified service.

RULE-BUILD-ENTRYPOINT.title: Application entrypoints and CLI bootstrapping
RULE-BUILD-ENTRYPOINT.description: Defines CLI entrypoints (cmd/*/main.go) responsible for command-line flag parsing, signal handling, and service execution.

RULE-INTERFACE-MOCK.title: In-memory test doubles and interface mocks
RULE-INTERFACE-MOCK.description: Defines mock implementations (MemoryFileSink, MemoryClipboardProvider, MockDialer) for test execution without requiring Android kernel drivers or physical hardware.

RULE-CONFIG-DISPATCH.title: Signaling and runtime configuration dispatch
RULE-CONFIG-DISPATCH.description: Handles configuration envelopes, environment variable overrides, and startup negotiation between signaling server and agent.

RULE-INERT-DISPATCHER.title: Inert channel topology and safe boundary enforcement
RULE-INERT-DISPATCHER.description: Ensures that deferred subsystems (AI execution engine, ADB daemon bridge) remain strictly non-operational and safe in production clean-room runtime.

RULE-HTTP-MIDDLEWARE.title: HTTP routing, CORS, and authentication middleware
RULE-HTTP-MIDDLEWARE.description: Standardized HTTP handler wrappers providing token verification, method enforcement, and cross-origin headers.

RULE-STORAGE-FILE.title: Atomic filesystem persistence and JSON store adapters
RULE-STORAGE-FILE.description: Implements thread-safe in-memory cache with atomic file serialization (write to tmp + atomic rename) with 0600 permissions.

RULE-CRYPTO-UTILITY.title: Cryptographic utility and token generation primitives
RULE-CRYPTO-UTILITY.description: Utility helpers wrapping crypto/rand and crypto/sha256 for session token generation and password verification.
